name: Account Number Not Empty
description: Every record must have an account number
business_rule: Account Number must not be null or empty

name: Non-Negative Closing Balance
business_rule: Closing Balance must be greater than or equal to zero

name: Valid Return Range
description: Net returns must be within realistic bounds
business_rule: Net Return must be between -1 and 1

name: Date Sequence Validation
description: Performance date must precede period end date
business_rule: Performance Date must be less than or equal to Period End Date

name: Gross Return Exceeds Net
description: Gross return should always be higher than net return due to fees
business_rule: Gross Return must be greater than or equal to Net Return

name: YTD Return Bounds Check
business_rule: YTD Return must be between -0.5 and 0.5 when Closing Balance is greater than 100000
